source.git_history: not available (source folder is not a usable git repository)
source.description: Pipeline converting East Coast (Dammam metropolitan area) architectural-character guides and style-zone maps into a coordinate-queryable knowledge base with per-item source tracking and a human review workflow.

geographic_accuracy.limitation: Maps were georeferenced with ESTIMATED control points at coastal landmarks, not survey measurements. Results are advisory architectural-character knowledge only - never legal zoning, never parcel-level determination, never official regulatory compliance.
geographic_accuracy.improvement_path: Survey-grade control points (6-10 per map) would raise accuracy from +-3 km to survey precision; template in the source package's 04_georeferencing/control_points/.

usage_notes: New/changed items always start as pending_review; pending knowledge is surfaced with warnings and never presented as approved guidance.
Sources are architectural-character guides (styles, facades, materials, composition) - they contain no quantitative municipal building requirements (setbacks, coverage ratios).
